name: Greek Roast Lamb Leg
ingredients: 1 Tbsp - Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Paprika, Thyme, Rosemary (1 Tbsp of each)
instructions: Mix the spices together in a bowl, then rub all over the leg of lamb.
Prepare the pan: select a casserole or roasting pan with a lid that just fits the size of meat you are cooking. If it doesn’t seal well, line the pan with tin foil and seal the foil around the meat.

Cook: Put all ingredients in casserole dish, add liquids 1/3 of the way up the leg. Cover with tight fitting lid or seal with tin foil. Bake for 5 hours and check if fork tender. It could take longer depending on the size of the leg. Add liquid if less than 1⁄4 of the way up the lamb.
Test for tender: Stab meat with a fork, it should slide in and out. It will ‘stick’ if the meat is not tender enough.
Serve: Cover meat and keep warm in a low oven. Strain sauce to separate the fat. Add salt, pepper and lemon to taste.

additional_context.tips: Suggested sides: Serve with rice, lemon potatoes, Greek salad and spanakopita.
